name: Plant Care
description: Your plants and when to water each one, with reminders of who is thirsty. Snap a plant and your AI identifies it and tells you how to care for it.
prompt: A plant care app with a list of plants, how often to water each, who is thirsty today, a water button and progress bars, and a camera button where the AI identifies the plant and suggests care and watering.
author: gonzaroman
